items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1957-multiple
items.q: We were twins. My sister's name, Ernestine Judy Miller, and my name is Ernest Punch Miller.

ctx.x: Now tell us, how did you get your name Punch? How did you get that nickname?
Oh, that nickname was from twins. We were twins. My sister's name, Ernestine Judy Miller, and my name is Ernest Punch Miller. So that's why we got the name. They called us Punch and Judy.
Is that a real middle name Judy?
